name: g2_calern_halpha_nov2026
label: C2PU 15 m east-west pair at H-alpha (1 nm), Delft SNSPDs and OCA APDs on the two outputs of a polarizing beam splitter: one night per target, the two branches combined in quadrature
notes: Campaign of 16-20 Nov 2026 (F. Izraelevitch, 2026-11-01): 20-30 h effective. The rows give the S/N per full night above 30 deg; scale by sqrt(hours / hours per night) for the time actually spent.

Targets: bright stars partially resolved at 15 m / 656 nm (3-8 mas), the two bright binaries (beta Aur: fringe period 41 m; Algol: 61 m), the red-clump giants (2.3-2.7 mas, |V|^2 ~ 0.8) and two Be stars with H-alpha discs.
